nom: Rael Miracle Clear Complete Acne Serum

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including some managing eczema, generally report no irritation and several note calmer, less red skin, though one reviewer with easily overexfoliated sensitive skin noted slight irritation at the tip of her nose.
segments.oily: Oily and combination-to-oily reviewers mostly report the serum helps control excess oil and reduces breakouts, though one reviewer with combination-to-oily skin found it only minimally moisturizing and somewhat drying.
segments.dry: The limited feedback from dry-skin reviewers is positive, describing the serum as hydrating and calming rather than drying.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers don't report dryness, and a few specifically say it hydrates without discomfort, but one reviewer with combination-to-oily skin found it only minimally moisturizing and a bit drying.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the serum reducing redness and calming inflammation, including around active breakouts and on eczema-prone cheeks, with no dissenting reports of increased redness.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report post-acne marks and scars fading with continued use, including one who specifically credits it with lightening old acne scars.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report smaller, faster-healing breakouts and fewer new ones, but several say they saw little to no improvement, particularly on larger or more stubborn pimples, and one noticed a new pimple appear where she had applied the serum.
concerns.oiliness: The small number of reviewers with oily skin report it helped calm excess oil, with no reports of it making skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without stickiness
Dropper is stiff and hard to squeeze
Can pill under makeup or other products
Slightly thicker, milky consistency, easy to control as a spot treatment

extraits.texte: I've been using this product faithfully 3x a day since Oct 2024, and I can honestly say, I've not seem any improvement in my whiteheads which are on my forehead, was really looking forward for this to work. SADLY NOT!

Maybe this thing does work well on me. With small acnes it worked ok. They're better next day. However the big pimples, I used 2 times daily but it took more than a week to see the improvement. So this product is good when you start seeing tiny acnes pop up

This product I used for about two weeks and it was fine. I didn't see a drastic improvement personally but I didn't see any additional acne breakouts so I believe that's good. I used this serum the week of my period cycle because that is usually the only time I experience breakouts but it didn't minimize the acne I already had it just stopped my skin from creating more. Which is why I'm indifferent because other products that I've used transform my skin overnight.

extraits.titre: Safe for my sensitive and eczema prone skin.
extraits.texte: I bought this two weeks ago and OMG — it has worked wonders. I had stubborn blemishes, acne, and blackheads on my cheeks. Since I have sensitive, eczema-prone skin, I was super reluctant to try this because I've had bad reactions to products like it before. But nope! This actually improved not just my blemishes, but also the redness on both of my cheeks. I also tried some of their other products and honestly, hands down the best decision I've ever made. Although, I'm not entirely sure if it's suitable for all eczema-prone skin types, but personally, I haven't had any issues.

I was so impressed after using this on my 17 year olds face who struggles with constant breakouts. After clesnsing, we put this on and i was impressed at how much his surface redness had toned down! After four consistent days of use, his skin is waaaay less red, there are no new breakouts and i can see a DEFINITE improvement in the active acne on his skin. The redness improved immediately and more so each day but im also pleased to see a drastic improvement in the texture of his skin as well. Im excited that i found a product that he notices a difference with as well! Ive tried so many things and nothing seemed to work and i couldnt get him to be consistent. But i think seeing a difference so soon gave him huge motivation to keep with it everyday.
I use this product in the AM with my regular face routine , I have oily skin and struggle with acne( some cystic) this product had definitely helped with healing and lightened my acne scars.
